title: Ernakulam district flood hazard probability and exposed facilities by return period
publisher: Kerala State Emergency Operations Centre / Kerala State Disaster Management Authority
source_section: Section 5.1, Ernakulam district, pages 49-50 in the PDF report
method_context: KSDMA report describes hydrological simulation with the Continuum model and hydraulic flood-hazard mapping; the historical and RCP 8.5 scenarios are distinct.
geographic_coverage: Ernakulam district aggregate, not Kochi Corporation or individual wards
return_period_definition: Approximate annual exceedance probability is 1 divided by the return period; for example, a 10-year event corresponds to about 10% in any given year. This is a statistical scenario, not a forecast that the event occurs once every N years.
limitations: These are source-reported district aggregates and cannot be assigned to Kochi Corporation, a ward, or a specific hospital.
Exposure counts depend on the source's facility inventory and methodology; they are not an independent revalidation by this project.
Historical and RCP 8.5 scenario results must not be mixed.
The statistics do not document the numeric units/semantics of the separate KSDMA GeoTIFF pixel values; raster-based spatial overlay remains blocked until those are verified.
This report supports historical/scenario context only, not live flood prediction or emergency warnings.
